CustomField.label: Match Confidence Score
CustomField.description: AI-generated confidence score for the emissions factor match. Range: 0.00-1.00 (0.00-0.50 = Low, 0.51-0.75 = Medium, 0.76-1.00 = High)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Confidence score indicating how certain the AI is about this match. Higher scores indicate more reliable matches.
